environment: Linux/Bun1.4.2; Jest/jsdom, real provider/hooks/button and browser bridge orchestration; external network, native identity and SessionClient fixture boundaries
scopeNotes: The full services run precedes the final asynchronous supersession guards and hook dependency cleanup; the final 4-suite/55-test run, TypeScript and Biome cover the final source.

Recovery uses fresh provider-owned registry lookup after null/error; known trusted classification retains the synchronous bridge path and introduces no extra registry request. No caller-supplied trust verdict.
Native and explicit-key tests reproduce SDK behavior; they do not demonstrate a backend exploit.

Isolated logout 503/network errors preserve session and report onError/runtime/rejected hook promise; retry/401/no-active-session paths covered.
No public API shape, contracts, API server, policy, package version or deployment changes.
